subject: Renewal + Upsell — PO & billing evidence for AcmeWorks
messages:
From: James Li <james.li@acmeworks.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@acmeworks.com>, billing@acmeworks.com
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase — PO and billing instructions

Hi Soojin,

We're ready to move forward on the upcoming Redwood renewal but need to make a few billing updates before we can issue a PO. Summary of what we need:

- Renewal term: extend annual renewal by +12 months starting 2028-06-01.
- Capacity increase: move from 4 dedicated units to 8 (effective at renewal start).
- Pricing: presuming previously quoted uplift (per Karthik) — please confirm final numbers and send amendment we can sign.
- Billing & PO: our procurement team will issue PO ACME-PO-4321 once billing contact & tax docs are in place.
- Net terms: Finance requests Net45. Please confirm Redwood accepts Net45 on this renewal.
- Tax paperwork: we need Redwood's invoice to reference our PO and we will attach our W-9.

Can you confirm acceptance of Net45 and send the contract amendment + invoice template so we can route the PO? If you need a contact on our side for procurement escalation it's me (james.li@acmeworks.com) and Maya (maya.patel@acmeworks.com) for finance.

Thanks,
James Li
Senior Procurement Manager
AcmeWorks

[Attachment: example_po_template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: James Li <james.li@acmeworks.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@acmeworks.com>, billing@acmeworks.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — PO and billing instructions

Hi James — thanks for the clear summary. Looping in Karthik (sales) and Neha (finance ops) to confirm pricing and next steps.

Quick answers up front:
- Net45: we can accept Net45 for this renewal (Finance has approved for enterprise deals).
- Capacity increase: we confirm the increment to 8 dedicated units at renewal start. Karthik will paste the final pricing in his note.
- PO: once we receive ACME-PO-4321 we will generate an invoice that references that PO number.
- Tax docs: please attach your W-9 in a reply so finance can match entity info.

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik confirms final MRR/annual pricing and prepares the amendment draft.
2) Procurement sends PO (ACME-PO-4321) and W-9 to billing@redwood.com (cc me).
3) Neha will issue an invoice dated on or around 2028-05-31 that references the PO and Net45 terms.

I've attached a first-pass amendment that covers the term extension and capacity increase — it's for sales/legal review.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_amendment_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: James Li <james.li@acmeworks.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@acmeworks.com>, billing@acmeworks.com
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — PO and billing instructions

Thanks all — confirming commercial details for the thread so finance has what they need.

- Seat/capacity change: 4 -> 8 dedicated units (2x) effective 2028-06-01.
- Annual committed spend (post-amendment): $1,200,000 (USD) — this is the committed capacity charge; usage-tiering unchanged.
- Term: +12 months from renewal effective date (2028-06-01 to 2029-05-31).
- Net terms: Net45 (approved).
- Deal id: DEAL-98765.

Soojin — I put language in the attached amendment to reflect the pricing table and PO acceptance flow. Legal okayed the standard amendment; if Acme needs any custom SOW language we'll handle that separately.

Neha — once you have the PO we should issue an invoice that includes: PO number (ACME-PO-4321), invoice date (we expect 2028-05-31), line items for the capacity uplift, and a note about Net45 terms. Please flag if Redwood needs W-9 or other tax evidence from Acme for entity validation.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

[Inline: pricing table pasted below]
- Existing committed units: 4 @ $12,500/unit/mo
- New committed units: 8 @ $12,000/unit/mo (volume discount applied)
- Annual commitment: $1,200,000
- One-time onboarding/setup charge: $15,000 (waived per promo)

James / Maya — received, thank you. Neha and the billing team confirm we have the PO and W-9 on file. Next steps: 

1) Redwood Finance will post an invoice that references ACME-PO-4321 and reflects Net45 terms. Invoice date: 2028-05-31 (expected).
2) Invoice will include line items for the capacity uplift and the annual commitment (per Karthik's pricing table).
3) We will upload the signed amendment to DocuSign and send a link for your countersignature.

I've attached the pro forma invoice we will issue so procurement can verify the PO mapping; once the invoice is posted we'll send a final PDF with the invoice number and payment instructions.

Thanks again — I'll follow up once the invoice is posted.
